label: Catholic Church: The institutional Church whose binding teaching office is exercised by the Roman…
definition: The institutional Church whose binding teaching office is exercised by the Roman Pontiff and the College of Bishops in communion with him, rather than any assertion by a member or office-holder. For definitive doctrinal proposal, the specified modes include the Roman Pontiff speaking ex cathedra, the College of Bishops gathered in council, and the ordinary and universal magisterium of bishops dispersed throughout the world in communion with the Pope. This is the subject of the CDF classification, used for the skeleton’s named Catholic society.
note: The source distinction is Doctrinal Commentary nn. 4–5 and 9. The classification is consulted as evidence of the Church’s proposal status; publication by the CDF is not thereby called a new solemn definition. This does not identify the modern society with the Church founded by Christ or establish divine authority; those remain separate skeleton premises.

formal_gap.meaning: Signature.catholicChurch is the case signature's named society: the institutional Church whose binding teaching office is exercised by the Roman Pontiff and the College of Bishops in communion with him (Doctrinal Commentary nn. 4–5, 9). It is a supplied element of the signature's Society type.
examples: The society in communion with the bishop of Rome, whose teaching office acts through the Pope speaking ex cathedra, an ecumenical council, or the ordinary and universal magisterium.
exclusions: An assertion by an individual member or office-holder is not an act of this subject.
The Church founded by Christ: identity with it is the separate open stage-6 premise STMT-CHRISTS-CHURCH-IS-THE-CATHOLIC-CHURCH.
Divine authority: being God-founded as teaching authority is the separate open premise stated by CatholicChurchIsGodFoundedTeachingAuthority.
open_obligations: That the named element denotes the intended society in a model is an interpretation supplied by the model.
Its historical identity with Christ's Church and its divine teaching authority remain open skeleton premises.
No formalization candidate: a named individual of a signature has no definition from other vocabulary.
